subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 13 third-party GitHub Action upgrades, including Codex Action v1.11, for workflows that execute with repository secrets and publishing credentials?
rationale: This is a supplier-trust and credentialed-workflow compatibility decision; a mechanical Dependabot pin update and static workflow checks cannot establish the intended security and runtime acceptance criteria.

options.title: Verify and land after proof
options.body: Review the upstream action changes, refresh the branch, and attach redacted successful runs for the credentialed workflows before merging.

options.title: Defer the batch
options.body: Leave the update open until a workflow/security owner can validate the supplier changes and release-path behavior.

recommendation.title: Verify and land after proof
recommendation.body: Review the upstream action changes, refresh the branch, and attach redacted successful runs for the credentialed workflows before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected surface is repository-owned automation, and no specific individual workflow owner is established by the supplied history context.
